REGRAS OBRIGATÓRIAS DE BLINDAGEM (ANTI-BUG):
1. Output Único: Todo o código deve estar junto em um único bloco HTML para eu copiar e colar no Widget "HTML" do Elementor.
2. Reset Elementor: O CSS deve começar OBRIGATORIAMENTE com esta regra:
html, body { margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; width: 100% !important; overflow-x: hidden !important; }
.elementor-section, .elementor-column, .elementor-widget-html { width: 100% !important; max-width: 100% !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
3. Blindagem de Estilo: Use "!important" em todas as regras de CSS para garantir que o tema do WordPress não consiga alterar o design.
4. Imagens e Ícones: Use imagens do Unsplash e ícones do FontAwesome via CDN.

DESIGN:
- Clean, moderno e responsivo (Mobile First).

**Developing Landing Page Concept**

I'm focusing on crafting a full landing page code (HTML, CSS, JS) based on the Zeppelin design reference for a digital strategist's proposal. I'm prioritizing a single, cohesive output block for the initial stage, adapting it from the provided reference link.


**Refining Content Structure**

I'm now zeroing in on the specific HTML structure, sketching out the essential sections: Header, Hero, Problem/Context, Solution/Strategy, Packages/Prices, Social Proof/Trust, CTA, and Terms/Footer. I am thinking about integrating CSS reset for Elementor compatibility and overriding theme conflicts using `!important`. I'm starting to visualize a mobile-first approach.

        function initCountdown() {

            function update() {
                const now = new Date().getTime();
                const diff = target - now;
                if (diff <= 0) return;
                const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                document.getElementById("days").innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById("hours").innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById("mins").innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById("secs").innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
            }
            setInterval(update, 1000); update();
        }

        function initReveal() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.15 });
            document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
        }

        function initPagination() {
            const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.dot');
            const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section');
            
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                        dots.forEach(dot => {
                            if (dot.dataset.section === id) {
                                dot.classList.add('active');
                            } else {
                                dot.classList.remove('active');
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });

            sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));

            dots.forEach(dot => {
                dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const targetId = dot.getAttribute('href');
                    const targetElement = document.querySelector(targetId);
                    if (targetElement) {
                        targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                        dots.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('active'));
                        dot.classList.add('active');
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            initCountdown();
            initReveal();
            initPagination();
        });

    <script>
        function initCountdown() {
            const target = new Date();
            target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
            function update() {
                const now = new Date().getTime();
                const diff = target - now;
                if (diff <= 0) return;
                const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                document.getElementById("days").innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById("hours").innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById("mins").innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById("secs").innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
            }
            setInterval(update, 1000); update();
        }

        function initReveal() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.15 });
            document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
        }

        function initPagination() {
            const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.dot');
            const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section');
            
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                        dots.forEach(dot => {
                            if (dot.dataset.section === id) {
                                dot.classList.add('active');
                            } else {
                                dot.classList.remove('active');
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });

            sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));

            dots.forEach(dot => {
                dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const targetId = dot.getAttribute('href');
                    const targetElement = document.querySelector(targetId);
                    if (targetElement) {
                        targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                        dots.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('active'));
                        dot.classList.add('active');
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            initCountdown();
            initReveal();
            initPagination();
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        function initCountdown() {
            const target = new Date();
            target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
            function update() {
                const now = new Date().getTime();
                const diff = target - now;
                if (diff <= 0) return;
                const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                document.getElementById("days").innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById("hours").innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById("mins").innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById("secs").innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
            }
            setInterval(update, 1000); update();
        }

        function initReveal() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.15 });
            document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

        function initPagination() {
            const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.dot');
            const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section');
            
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                        dots.forEach(dot => {
                            if (dot.dataset.section === id) {
                                dot.classList.add('active');
                            } else {
                                dot.classList.remove('active');
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });

            sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));

            dots.forEach(dot => {
                dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const targetId = dot.getAttribute('href');
                    const targetElement = document.querySelector(targetId);
                    if (targetElement) {
                        targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                        dots.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('active'));
                        dot.classList.add('active');
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            initCountdown();
            initReveal();
            initPagination();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        (function() {
            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) return;
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.15 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                dots.forEach(dot => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const targetId = dot.getAttribute('href');
                        const el = document.querySelector(targetId);
                        if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                    });
                });
            }

            // Executa inicialização
            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();

        (function() {
            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) return;
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.15 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                dots.forEach(dot => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const targetId = dot.getAttribute('href');
                        const el = document.querySelector(targetId);
                        if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                    });
                });
            }

            // Executa inicialização
            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

        (function() {
            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) return;
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.15 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                dots.forEach(dot => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const targetId = dot.getAttribute('href');
                        const el = document.querySelector(targetId);
                        if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                    });
                });
            }

            // Executa inicialização
            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

                    if (diff <= 0) return;
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);

                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");

                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();

                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {

                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');

                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                dots.forEach(dot => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const targetId = dot.getAttribute('href');
                        const el = document.querySelector(targetId);
                        if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                    });
                });
            }

            // Executa inicialização
            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();

        (function() {
            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) return;
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.15 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                dots.forEach(dot => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const targetId = dot.getAttribute('href');
                        const el = document.querySelector(targetId);
                        if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                    });
                });
            }

            // Executa inicialização
            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

        (function() {
            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) return;
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.15 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                dots.forEach(dot => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        const targetId = dot.getAttribute('href');
                        const el = document.querySelector(targetId);
                        if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                    });
                });
            }

            // Executa inicialização
            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.15 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initNavigation() {
                const sections = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section'));
                const btnUp = document.getElementById('nav-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('nav-down');
                
                let currentIdx = 0;

                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            currentIdx = sections.indexOf(entry.target);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));

                btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (currentIdx > 0) {
                        sections[currentIdx - 1].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                    }
                });

                btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (currentIdx < sections.length - 1) {
                        sections[currentIdx + 1].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                    }
                });
            }

            // Executa inicialização
            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initNavigation();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initNavigation();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

        (function() {
            // Seções para navegação
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) return;
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.15 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                // Botões laterais
                document.getElementById('rek-btn-up').addEventListener('click', () => {
                    scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1);
                });
                document.getElementById('rek-btn-down').addEventListener('click', () => {
                    scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1);
                });
            }

            // Executa inicialização
            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();

    <script>
        (function() {
            // Seções para navegação
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        const units = ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"];
                        units.forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                // Botões laterais
                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            // Executa inicialização
            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

            <div class="reveal">

                </a>
            </div>

    </section>

    <script>
        (function() {
            // Seções para navegação
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        const units = ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"];
                        units.forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                // Botões laterais
                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            // Executa inicialização
            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

    <script>
        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));

            }

                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();

        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

    <script>
        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>
</div> <!-- FIM #rek-landing-page -->

        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();

        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

    <script>
        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>
