            <div class="countdown-grid reveal" id="countdown">
                <div class="count-unit"><span class="count-num" id="days">00</span><span class="count-label">Dias</span></div>
                <div class="count-unit"><span class="count-num" id="hours">00</span><span class="count-label">Horas</span></div>

    <script>
        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>
</div> <!-- FIM #rek-landing-page -->

    <script>
        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            currentSectionIndex = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            dots.forEach(dot => {
                                dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

        (function() {
            // Atualizado para incluir o contato (ID do footer)
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar', 'contato'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section, #rek-landing-page footer');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            const idx = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                                dots.forEach(dot => {
                                    dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => {
                    if (s.id && sectionsList.includes(s.id)) observer.observe(s);
                });
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

        (function() {
            // Lista completa com as 8 seções
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar', 'contato'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function syncDots(id) {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                dots.forEach(dot => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                });
            }

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                    // Sincronização manual para feedback imediato
                    syncDots(targetId);
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) return;
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.15 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section, #rek-landing-page footer');
                
                // Observer mais sensível para garantir que o rodapé ative o último ponto
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            const idx = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                                syncDots(id);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { 
                    threshold: [0.1, 0.3, 0.5], // Múltiplos limites para maior precisão
                    rootMargin: "-5% 0px -5% 0px" 
                });
                
                sections.forEach(s => {
                    if (s.id && sectionsList.includes(s.id)) observer.observe(s);
                });

                // Clique nos pontos
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                // Botões de subir/descer
                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));

                // Detecção de fim de página para forçar ativação do último dot
                window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                    if ((window.innerHeight + window.scrollY) >= document.body.offsetHeight - 50) {
                        syncDots('contato');
                        currentSectionIndex = 7;
                    }
                });
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>
</div> <!-- FIM #rek-landing-page -->

        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar', 'contato'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function syncDots(id) {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                dots.forEach(dot => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                });
            }

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                    syncDots(targetId);
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) return;
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    document.getElementById("days").innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    document.getElementById("hours").innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    document.getElementById("mins").innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    document.getElementById("secs").innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.15 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section, #rek-landing-page footer');
                
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            const idx = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                                syncDots(id);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { 
                    threshold: [0.1, 0.3, 0.5],
                    rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" 
                });
                
                sections.forEach(s => {
                    if (s.id && sectionsList.includes(s.id)) observer.observe(s);
                });

                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));

                // Detecção forçada para o fim da página (Garante ativação do último dot)
                window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                    if ((window.innerHeight + window.scrollY) >= document.body.offsetHeight - 60) {
                        syncDots('contato');
                        currentSectionIndex = 7;
                    }
                });
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

        (function() {
            // Atualizado para incluir o contato (ID do footer)
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar', 'contato'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section, #rek-landing-page footer');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            const idx = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                                dots.forEach(dot => {
                                    dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => {
                    if (s.id && sectionsList.includes(s.id)) observer.observe(s);
                });
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

**Refining User Experience**

I'm now focusing on incorporating a "Value Perception" section before the final investment details for this Senior Frontend Engineer. It needs to clearly articulate the value proposition to the Elementor/WordPress expert. The site itself should remain exactly as it is, with no changes to the visual design elements.


**Adding Value Proposition**

I've crafted a new "Value Perception" section, complete with a title and itemized breakdown of services. This new block, titled "SERVIÇOS INCLUSOS + VALOR DE MERCADO" with an itemized list of offerings and a total value of R$ 29.500, will be inserted. I will need to be careful with the price as the user said not to change anything, but there is some confusion, so I'll check again. The existing investment section remains untouched, reflecting the R$ 1.950/month price.


**Implementing New Cost Analysis**

I'm now integrating the "Análise de Custo x Benefício" block within the `#preco` section, right before the `investment-card`. The new block will mirror the user's provided code structure and CSS classes. The specific details, like Meta Ads at R$1,500 with a 6-month contract and payment terms, are being incorporated. It's designed to align precisely with the user's existing style, focusing on a clear presentation of value.



**Verifying Implementation Details**

I'm now cross-referencing the `index.html` structure to confirm section IDs and ensure the scrolling behavior functions correctly, especially for the new additions. I'm prioritizing adherence to the user's explicit request to maintain the existing visual design, particularly regarding font sizes and overall aesthetics. This means leveraging their existing styles and adding *minimal* specific styling for list items, maintaining professional aesthetics without altering the user's established visual design. I am also checking to be sure that the text is the one provided, and not the prior turn.

Para atender ao seu pedido com a máxima precisão, inseri a seção de **Percepção de Valor de Mercado** exatamente antes da sua proposta de investimento. Este bloco foi projetado para destacar o alto valor dos serviços individuais, criando o contraste psicológico necessário para que o cliente perceba o quão vantajosa é a sua oferta final.

**Especificações da atualização:**
- **Conteúdo Fiel:** Transcrição exata de todos os serviços e valores solicitados (R$ 8.000, R$ 4.000, R$ 2.500, R$ 2.500).
- **Destaque do Total:** Inclusão do banner de "Valor Total de Mercado" com o destaque para **R$ 29.500**.
- **Preservação Total:** Nenhuma outra informação (valores de honorários, cronograma de pagamento, garantia, depoimentos ou estilos visuais) foi alterada. O site permanece idêntico em todas as outras partes.
- **Design:** Mantive o padrão visual de cards escuros com bordas sutis e animações de revelação para não quebrar a unidade estética do projeto.

    <script>
        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar', 'contato'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section, #rek-landing-page footer');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            const idx = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                                dots.forEach(dot => {
                                    dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => {
                    if (s.id && sectionsList.includes(s.id)) observer.observe(s);
                });
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

    <script>
        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'finalizar', 'contato'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section, #rek-landing-page footer');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            const idx = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                                dots.forEach(dot => {
                                    dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => {
                    if (s.id && sectionsList.includes(s.id)) observer.observe(s);
                });
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

        (function() {
            // LISTA DE SEÇÕES ATUALIZADA COM O NOVO PONTO DE NAVEGAÇÃO
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'proposta', 'finalizar', 'contato'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section, #rek-landing-page footer, #proposta');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            const idx = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                                dots.forEach(dot => {
                                    dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => {
                    if (s.id && sectionsList.includes(s.id)) observer.observe(s);
                });
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

    <script>
        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'proposta', 'finalizar', 'contato'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section, #rek-landing-page footer, #proposta');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            const idx = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                                dots.forEach(dot => {
                                    dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => {
                    if (s.id && sectionsList.includes(s.id)) observer.observe(s);
                });
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>

                            <span>Site: <a href="https://www.leorek.com.br" target="_blank">www.leorek.com.br</a></span>
                        </li>
                        <li class="contact-item">
                            <i class="fas fa-id-card"></i>
                            <span>CNPJ: 58.845.816/0001-04</span>
                        </li>
                    </ul>

            </div>

                <p>© 2026 Leonardo Rek - Todos os direitos reservados.</p>
                <p>Desenvolvido por Estratégia Digital Rek</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </footer>

    <script>
        (function() {
            const sectionsList = ['hero', 'bio', 'escopo', 'timeline', 'garantia', 'preco', 'proposta', 'finalizar', 'contato'];
            let currentSectionIndex = 0;

            function scrollToIdx(idx) {
                if(idx < 0 || idx >= sectionsList.length) return;
                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                const targetId = sectionsList[idx];
                const targetEl = document.getElementById(targetId);
                if(targetEl) {
                    targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

            function initCountdown() {
                const target = new Date();
                target.setHours(target.getHours() + 48);
                function update() {
                    const now = new Date().getTime();
                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section, #rek-landing-page footer, #proposta');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            const idx = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                                dots.forEach(dot => {
                                    dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => {
                    if (s.id && sectionsList.includes(s.id)) observer.observe(s);
                });
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>
</div> <!-- FIM #rek-landing-page -->

**Implementing Responsive Styles**

                    const diff = target - now;
                    if (diff <= 0) {
                        ["days", "hours", "mins", "secs"].forEach(id => {
                            const el = document.getElementById(id);
                            if(el) el.innerText = "00";
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    const d = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                    const h = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    const elD = document.getElementById("days");
                    const elH = document.getElementById("hours");
                    const elM = document.getElementById("mins");
                    const elS = document.getElementById("secs");
                    if(elD) elD.innerText = d.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elH) elH.innerText = h.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elM) elM.innerText = m.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    if(elS) elS.innerText = s.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                }
                setInterval(update, 1000); update();
            }

            function initReveal() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('active');
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.1 });
                document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
            }

            function initPagination() {
                const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page .dot');
                const sections = document.querySelectorAll('#rek-landing-page section, #rek-landing-page footer, #proposta');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const id = entry.target.getAttribute('id');
                            const idx = sectionsList.indexOf(id);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                currentSectionIndex = idx;
                                dots.forEach(dot => {
                                    dot.classList.toggle('active', dot.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3, rootMargin: "-10% 0px -10% 0px" });
                
                sections.forEach(s => {
                    if (s.id && sectionsList.includes(s.id)) observer.observe(s);
                });
                
                dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                    dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        scrollToIdx(idx);
                    });
                });

                const btnUp = document.getElementById('rek-btn-up');
                const btnDown = document.getElementById('rek-btn-down');
                if(btnUp) btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex - 1));
                if(btnDown) btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToIdx(currentSectionIndex + 1));
            }

            if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
                initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
            } else {
                document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
                    initCountdown(); initReveal(); initPagination();
                });
            }
        })();
    </script>
</div> <!-- FIM #rek-landing-page -->
